name: branding-teardrop-lettered-nava-wordmark-with-sign-and-laptop
title: Bulbous geometric 'nava' wordmark with 'Structure meets vision' tagline, on a dark sign and laptop
whatItIs: A white slide with a black lowercase wordmark where each letter is built from quarter-circles and teardrops with pointed corners, a wide-tracked caps tagline and two photos: a dark projecting sign on a stone wall and the mark on a laptop screen.
whatItMeans: Confident and architectural; soft curves with sharp points feel like designed rooms.
techniques: Leave one sharp corner per curve for character.
Show reversed on a dark sign.

vocabulary.definition: A single pointed corner on a rounded form.
A sign mounted perpendicular to a wall.
